prompt: Hi. I want to became a SME in Servicenow CSM. Could you guide me?
response: To become a ServiceNow Certified Service Manager (CSM), you need to pass the CSM certification exam. This exam tests your knowledge of ServiceNow best practices and your ability to manage service-oriented processes. You can prepare for the exam by studying the ServiceNow Certified Service Manager Certification Guide. It's also beneficial to have hands-on experience with ServiceNow and to participate in the ServiceNow community to gain insights from experienced professionals.
